Name: Content Code
Author: spacechase0
Description:
[b]Content Code[/b] lets content packs run C# at certain points in the game.

[b][size=5]Install[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url]﻿.
[*]Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[b][size=5]Use[/size][/b]
[b][size=3]For players[/size][/b]
This mod does nothing on its own; you need to install content packs by unzipping them into your [font=Courier New]Mods[/font] folder. See [i]Requirements[/i] > [i]Mods requiring this file[/i] above to find content packs.

[b][size=3]For mod authors[/size][/b]
See the [url=https://github.com/spacechase0/StardewValleyMods/blob/develop/ContentCode/docs/author-guide.md]author guide[/url] for more info. (Also in the mod zip file for the first release.)


[b][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/b]
Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.5.5+ on Linux/macOS/Windows, both single-player and multiplayer.
